chapter: Small group, new sound and Europe
title: Let go for two months and working with Lester Young at Birdland
summary: When Basie cut down to a small group Greene was let go for two months, worked with Lester, then was recalled.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Yeah. Do you remember that period with the small group fairly well?
Yeah. I remember it.
Who was the small group, Freddie, can you think?
Clark Terry?
Let's see -- first they started -- well -- the small group -- when they first started with the small group -- when they started cutting down, in other words --
Yeah.
-- they cut everybody down -- including me.
Including you?
Oh, yeah.
I didn't know that.
Yeah. I was -- you know.
There was a time when you weren't there?
Yeah. I was out of the group for about 2 months.
No kidding?
And all of a sudden. I said 'well, I don't know' you know. For some reason they said 'we'd better get him back'.
Is that right?
That's when I went and played with Lester Young. Down at Birdland.
Is that right?
See, right after they let me go, then I worked with Lester Young in Birdland
Is that right. Who else was with you then? Can you think?
With Lester?
Yeah.
Oh. I think Lester, and myself and --
Was it Lee, or --
Hm-mm. I don't think Lee was there. I'm trying to think of the piano player. He's in Europe now. He used to play with Lester before. Remember him?
Kenny Drew
Huh?
Kenny Drew
Kenny. I think it was Kenny.
Oh, yeah?
I think Kenny was there. Yeah. And, myself.
Any other horns?
I'm trying to think who we had on drums.
Well, they had some funny bands around. (laugh).
(laugh) I know. I'm trying to think who was playing drums. I can't remember who was playing drums. I worked with Lester, you know.
Is that right? I didn't know you were ever out of the Basie band.
Mm hmm. Two months.
Two months.
The most miserable two months (laugh) I've ever seen in my life.
No kidding. Yeah.
You know -- after being there so long.
You just thought -- 'What did the future hold?'.
Yeah, right. At night, you know, I dreamt about the band.
Yeah.
But then, they called me back after two months.
Who called you back? Basie, or a manager, or who?
I think a manager called me back.
What was his name? You know, the famous guy with the funny name?
Big? He was big? Six foot something? What was his name? With glasses. He wore glasses.
Oh?
He's a big guy with glasses.
Yeah. I can't think of his name. But, anyway -- that small group didn't last long, did it?
No. Not too long.
